messages:
Maya: Quick sync — final pass on compact landing copy for the microlaunch. Need a single storyboard that covers Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private pages + clear webinar registration routing. Goal: launch posts + webinar signup funnel this week. Benchmarks to include: webinar sign rate target 10%, hosted trial->paid 3%, Dedicated POC leads >5. Who owns what?
Sam: I can own landing->webinar flow and the launch posts. Quick q: are we gating webinar with a form or magic link? leaning form for SDR signal.
Eli: I’ll draft two hero variants (product-first, econ-first) and short mode blurbs. Early hero lines: Hosted — "Start with our managed API for fast time-to-value." Dedicated — "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput." Private — "Run inference in your VPC with enterprise controls." Will iterate.
Zara: SEO vs conversion tradeoff — recommend a single canonical page with three clear paths (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and a hero that nudges to the webinar CTA. We should A/B hero vs three-column toggle.
Jordan: Inbound routing plan: use UTMs to tag mode and source, then map to CRM queues. Proposal (sample):
```
utm_source=organic|paid|twitter&utm_campaign=compact_launch_4387&utm_mode=hosted|dedicated|private
```
Routing: hosted -> SDR pool A, dedicated -> AE pool B, private -> Enterprise AE + CSM alert. I’ll add mapping to the doc and create the Salesforce assignment rules.
Sam: Also want a follow-up sequence for webinar registrants: immediate confirmation + short benchmark email (latency vs cost comparisons), then two nurture emails with short product snippets and a CTA to trial or schedule POC. Need eng-ml numbers for benchmark assets.
Eli: For copy variants I’ll do: hero, 3 short mode cards, 3 nav blurbs, webinar CTAs and the post-webinar email templates. Will drop copy snippets into the shared doc by 2pm.
Maya: @Jordan can you add the exact CRM queue names and the routing triggers? Also @Eli please tag any stats you need from eng-ml.
Jordan: Yup — will add mapping and sample Salesforce flow. Quick sample to paste into ops doc:
```
if utm_mode=="hosted": assign_to=SDR_A
if utm_mode=="dedicated": assign_to=AE_B
if utm_mode=="private": assign_to=ENT_AE_AND_CSM
```
ops-bot: Shared doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/compact-launch/landing-storyboard (permissions: marketing + sales).
Sam: Timing: draft launch post + schedule for social + webinar registration page by EOD Thu. We should have creative for hero A/B and the benchmark PDF.
Eli: Need latency/token and 99th pct numbers from eng-ml for the benchmark PDF. @eng-ml — pinged.
Maya: OK team — owners: Sam (launch posts + webinar flow), Eli (copy + emails), Jordan (inbound routing + CRM), Zara (measurement and A/B). Sync 3pm to lock hero and routing. :calendar:
Zara: 3pm works for me. I’ll bring the measurement plan and primary KPI dashboard.
Maya: Perfect. If anyone finds page copy that reads too vendor-y, flag it in the doc and tag me. We want short, clear customer outcomes. :sparkles:
